profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer @ Thoughtly
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I have over 8 years of experience developing software full stack. I have experience in many technologies such as TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Node, Postgres, MongoDB, C++, and more.

I am a Full-Stack Software Engineer at Thoughtly, utilizing AI and STT/TTS models to power voice agents. I contributed to developing our workflow builders, empowering customers to create their own agents and automations enhanced by AI and integrated with tools such as Salesforce and Hubspot.
